parsed.reason: Description A says an expired entry popped before the size check can cause an unrelated live entry to be evicted needlessly (a cache-capacity waste issue). Description B says find returns the shared cached list object, so in-place sorting by a caller mutates the cache and corrupts later results' ordering. Different defects: one is eviction efficiency, the other is aliasing/mutation of cached state.
